name: Ferrocast NP-3 Neural Port Cap
description:
A snug-fitting skullcap in matte charcoal stretch-neoprene with a reinforced crown panel of injection-molded ABS. Three pre-positioned port-access grommets align with standard BCI hardware configurations — each ringed with a brushed-steel collar and a snap-shut silicone dust cover. The interior is lined with conductive mesh that grounds ambient static away from exposed jack contacts.

Functional over fashionable, it sits low on the brow and high on the nape. Common in factory floors and transit hubs where exposed neural ports risk snagging on equipment or collecting industrial particulate.
functionality: Protects exposed neural port hardware from dust, moisture, and snag hazards. Grounding mesh reduces static discharge risk near high-voltage equipment. Snap-shut silicone covers keep contacts clean between connections. Port alignment is compatible with Axiom, Helix, and Stratum standard BCI jack spacing.
what_it_says: You're augmented, working, and smart enough to protect your hardware without spending on aesthetics.
story_hooks: A batch of NP-3s shipped to a Circuit factory were found to have conductive mesh wired to passively log neural port serial numbers — someone is tracking augmented workers.
A transit operator's NP-3 cap shows burn scoring around one port grommet consistent with a surge event that should have been lethal — the cap absorbed it somehow.
A Tier 2 union organizer uses the cap's grounding mesh to covertly suppress BCI signal broadcasting during illegal assembly meetings.
related_entities: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.visual_profile: A utilitarian skullcap that hugs the head like a second skin, designed around the practical reality of exposed neural ports. The matte charcoal body recedes into the background while three brushed-steel port collars command attention across the crown—industrial, functional, unadorned. Sits low and tight, emphasizing the back of the skull and nape.
physical_description.fit: Snug, compression-like fit across the entire scalp. Stretches to accommodate port hardware without shifting. Sits deliberately low on the brow to protect, high on the nape for full coverage. No excess fabric—engineered for contact work.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte charcoal stretch-neoprene body with injection-molded ABS reinforcement crown panel. Brushed-steel grommet collars and silicone dust covers at each port access point. Conductive mesh lining underneath.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly tacky neoprene exterior with a faint grip texture. Crown panel is rigid ABS with a slightly grainy, industrial finish. Steel collars are brushed—catching light but not reflective. Silicone covers are matte, designed for repeated opening/closing.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant matte charcoal gray with brushed-steel metallic accents at the three port collars. Silicone dust covers in muted gunmetal or matching gray. Minimal contrast—designed for visual subtlety in workspace environments.
physical_description.closures: Silicone snap-shut dust covers over each of the three port grommets. No traditional closures on the cap itself—stretch-fit secures it to the head with passive tension.
distinctive_features: Three pre-positioned BCI port-access grommets arranged across the crown in standard hardware configuration
Brushed-steel collars ringed around each grommet for reinforcement and visual definition
Snap-shut silicone dust covers to protect exposed jacks from debris and moisture
Interior conductive mesh lining for static dissipation and port protection
Injection-molded ABS reinforcement panel under crown stress points
Low-profile design minimizes snag risk on industrial equipment
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 functional. Affordable protective hardware for working-class neural-augmented laborers. Not luxury, not salvage—purpose-built for the factory floor and transit hub.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by factory workers, transit operators, warehouse staff, and anyone with exposed BCI hardware in high-contact environments. Signals augmentation without status. Communicates pragmatism and industrial work life. Common in the ungoverned zones around the GLMZ's manufacturing sectors.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn appearance standard—minor dust residue on the grommets, slight discoloration on the nape where sweat accumulates, dust covers showing micro-scratches from repeated use. Not pristine, but well-maintained by someone who depends on their ports staying clean.
